`sglang/qwen4exp-serving-73a255206f.patch` is the serving patch, against SGLang at commit `73a255206f`
(the `main` branch on 2.py --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --prompt-tokens 101 421 1701 6821 10001 --max-tokens 128
```

`scripts/serve.sh` is the launcher that produced the published numbers. It sets the environment, applies the
patch list, launches SGLang and waits for `/health`. The published configuration is `--max-running-requests 1`
with `--enable-ple`; `--enable-ple` is the only way to reach the full 262,144-token context on 24 GB (CAMPAIGN.md:448).

contains `ple.json` and `ple.f8_e4m3.bin`.

`sglang/qwen4exp-serving-73a255206f.patch` is the serving patch, against SGLang at commit `73a255206f`
(the `main` branch on 2026-07-28). It is the single artifact that makes.py --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --prompt-tokens 101 421 1701 6821 10001 --max-tokens 128
```

`scripts/serve.sh` is the launcher that produced the published numbers. It sets the environment, applies the
patch list, launches SGLang and waits for `/health`. The published configuration is `--max-running-requests 1`
with `--enable-ple`; `--enable-ple` is the only way to reach the full 262,144-token context on 24 GB (CAMPAIGN.md:448).
The PLE table is read from `PLE` (default `~/quant/model/ple`); `--ple-weights-dir` is the directory that
contains `ple.json` and `ple.f8_e4m3.bin`.

## Repository layout

```
sglang/         the serving patch (qwen4exp-serving-73a255206f.patch) and the layered patch scripts it was built from
patches/        the serving patch's individual layers (kv_tiers.py, ple.py, elastic.py, ...)
kernels/        the Triton kernels the patch JIT-compiles (int2 gemm, int4 KV cache, int8 ring, PLE gather)
tools/          the measurement tools (bench.py, nll.py, ...)
docs/           the design documents and the engineering log (docs/CAMPAIGN.md)
docs/logs/      the dated logs of the runs that produced the published numbers
assets/         the accepted state (phase1_state.json) and the PLE table's schema (ple.json)
scripts/        the launcher (serve.sh) and the scripts that produced the logs
```
